name: summary_vs_detail
detail: Mastercard summary days whose count or net differs from the detail rows; not compared, outside the detail file's settlement dates: 2026-08-31

name: clearing_days_vs_entries
detail: processor clearing days with no ledger entry, or an entry posted on another date

name: settlements_vs_debits
detail: settlement days and debits that do not pair

name: net_formula
detail: Mastercard rows whose net is not amount - interchange + scheme fee

name: statuses
detail: rows kept out of money (AUTHORIZED 25, DECLINED 20); passes unless a status is unknown or a row with it has a clearing date

name: stale_authorisations
detail: authorised rows older than the stale limit in working days, from the authorisation date

name: references
detail: cleared rows whose network reference is empty, mistyped or needed normalising

name: card_numbers
detail: rows holding a 13-19 digit string that is not a Mastercard reference

name: missing_inputs
detail: inputs that are absent or unreadable (never estimated): processor invoice

name: cash_reconciled
detail: ledger cash less reconciling items, against the bank

name: inputs_cover_period
detail: dated input files that are missing or unreadable, or whose period column does not span the first to the last working day of the period

name: checklist_tasks_owned
detail: close-checklist tasks that are missing or have no owner_role (none)
